name_en: Anmochi zoni — white miso zoni with a sweet red-bean-filled rice cake
summary_ja: 煮干し出汁に大根と金時人参、あん入りの丸餅を煮て、最後に白味噌を溶き入れる正月の雑煮。江戸期に貴重だった砂糖を使い切る一年一度のごちそうとして始まったと伝わる。
summary_en: A New Year zoni made by simmering daikon, kintoki carrot, and a round rice cake filled with sweet red bean paste in dried-sardine broth, finished with white miso. Said to have begun as a once-a-year treat using sugar, once a costly commodity in the Edo period.
source_title: あんもち雑煮 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Kagawa dojo jiru — loach and vegetable soup thickened with hand-cut wheat noodles
summary_ja: ごぼうや里芋、打ち込み用のうどんとともにドジョウを煮込んだ夏バテ予防の汁物。田植え後、男たちがため池でとったドジョウを、集落の寄り合いで大釜で炊いて振る舞ってきたという。
summary_en: Loach is simmered with burdock, taro, and hand-cut wheat noodles into a soup eaten to fend off summer fatigue. After rice planting, men once caught loach from irrigation ponds and cooked it in a communal cauldron to share at village gatherings.
source_title: どじょう汁 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ebi miso jiru — small Seto shrimp pureed into a white miso soup
summary_ja: 殻ごとすりつぶした小エビを米のとぎ汁でのばし、白味噌と豆腐を加えて煮る汁物。三豊市豊中町の宇賀神社で約300年続くどぶろく祭りに、神事の振る舞い料理として添えられてきたという。
summary_en: Small shell-on shrimp are pureed with rice rinse water, then simmered with white miso and tofu. Served as part of the roughly 300-year-old sacred sake festival at Uga Shrine in Toyonaka, Mitoyo, where it has long accompanied the shrine's home-brewed doburoku.
source_title: えびみそ汁 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_ja: こんにゃくのはちはい
name_en: Konnyaku no hachihai — konjac simmered in dashi, soy sauce, and sake
summary_ja: 三角に薄切りしたこんにゃくを、里芋や干ししいたけとともに出汁で煮る。名の由来は、あっさりとした味に八杯おかわりした人がいたから、出汁と醤油と酒を八杯ずつ使うからなど諸説あるという。
summary_en: Konjac sliced into thin triangles is simmered with taro and dried shiitake in dashi. The name's origin has several theories — that someone once had eight helpings of its light flavor, or that dashi, soy sauce, and sake are each measured out eight cups at a time.
source_title: こんにゃくのはちはい 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Uchikomi jiru — hand-cut wheat noodles simmered straight into a vegetable soup
summary_ja: 塩を使わず小麦粉と水だけでこねた生地を切って、別ゆでせずそのまま大根や人参の出汁に入れて煮込む冬の汁物。うどんが身近な小麦どころ香川らしい、手早くつくれる農村の日常食だという。
summary_en: Dough kneaded from just wheat flour and water, without salt, is cut and simmered straight into a dashi with daikon and carrot, without pre-boiling — a winter soup. Said to be a quick everyday dish from Kagawa, a wheat-growing region where udon is part of daily life.
source_title: 打ち込み汁 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
